answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 994 Country: India Title: While travelling and having Qasar Namaz if a namaz like Zuhr was Qaza, how to make the Qaza in the journey itself? Question: While travelling and having Qasar Namaz if a namaz like Zuhr was Qaza, how to make the Qaza in the journey itself? Answer ID: 994 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 394=391/M) While being on a journey, if someone misses any Salah (for example Zuhr ) then he has to make it up two rakats only whether he prays it in journey or at home. And, this will be performed with the intention of making up Zuhr Qasr : فیقضی مسافر فی السفر ۔۔۔ مافاتہ فی السفر منھا رکعتین (عالمگیری: 1/121) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
